policy: These reviews approve only human use of the official links within the publisher, instrument, language, date, provisions and limits checked. No local PDF or converted text is accepted, copied for reuse, or authorized for republication. A source reference does not establish full topic coverage or country completion.

gr-pd106-2007-original.publisher: National Printing House of the Hellenic Republic
gr-pd106-2007-original.version_or_cutoff: Original publication: FEK 135/A, 21 June 2007; this 12-page decree does not contain later amendments.
gr-pd106-2007-original.scope: PD 106/2007 implementing Directive 2004/38/EC on EU citizens and their family members.
gr-pd106-2007-original.reviewed_content: The official PDF identifies the Gazette issue, date, decree number and subject; its preamble identifies Directive 2004/38/EC. The decree is the base text only.
limitations: Not a consolidated current text.
Read the provisions relevant to the question with the targeted amendments reviewed separately: Law 4071/2012 Article 42, Law 4540/2018 Article 32, and Law 5275/2026 Article 53.
Greek is the controlling language.
No local copy or republication permission is approved by this link review.

gr-law4071-2012-art42.publisher: National Printing House of the Hellenic Republic
gr-law4071-2012-art42.reviewed_content: The official issue identifies Law 4071/2012 and Article 42. Article 42 amends provisions in PD 106/2007 Articles 2, 3, 6–9, 16, 17 and 22.
limitations: Article 42 only; the issue is not a consolidated decree.
Greek is the controlling language.
No local copy or republication permission is approved by this link review.

gr-law4540-2018-art32.publisher: National Printing House of the Hellenic Republic; official Gazette copy hosted by the Ministry of Migration and Asylum
gr-law4540-2018-art32.version_or_cutoff: Law 4540/2018, FEK 91/A, 22 May 2018; full 28-page Gazette issue inspected.
gr-law4540-2018-art32.scope: Article 32 amendment to PD 106/2007 Articles 2(2) and 3(2).
gr-law4540-2018-art32.reviewed_content: The PDF bears the Official Gazette issue identity; Article 32 expressly replaces Article 2(2) and Article 3(2) of PD 106/2007. The Ministry index and MITOS record link the original National Printing House entry.
limitations: This is a targeted amending act, not a consolidation.
Greek is the controlling language.
No local copy or republication permission is approved by this link review.

gr-law5275-2026-art53.publisher: National Printing House of the Hellenic Republic
gr-law5275-2026-art53.scope: Article 53 amendment to PD 106/2007 Article 3(2), changing the residence-document duration for specified other-family-member and stable-partner categories to a five-year Residence Card under Article 10.
gr-law5275-2026-art53.reviewed_content: The official PDF identifies Law 5275/2026 and FEK 17/A. Article 53 replaces the previous two-year residence-permit wording with a five-year Residence Card under Article 10; Article 69 provides that the law enters into force on publication unless a provision states otherwise. The targeted Article 53 change therefore took effect on 6 February 2026.
limitations: Applies to Article 3(2) categories only; not all EU-family residence documents.
This amending law is not a consolidated PD 106/2007 text.
Greek is the controlling language.
No local copy or republication permission is approved by this link review.

gr-law4686-2020-art43.publisher: National Printing House of the Hellenic Republic; official Gazette copy hosted by the Ministry of Migration and Asylum
gr-law4686-2020-art43.version_or_cutoff: Law 4686/2020, FEK 96/A, 12 May 2020; full official 24-page Gazette PDF inspected.
gr-law4686-2020-art43.scope: Article 43 transitional residence-document rules for specified EU-family and Greek-family cases under the former KYA 23443/2011, including references to PD 106/2007.
gr-law4686-2020-art43.reviewed_content: Article 43(1) addresses specified holders of older KYA-issued permits and possible permanent-residence documents under PD 106/2007 Article 13; Article 43(2) addresses certain personal residence rights under PD 106/2007 Articles 11 and 12.
limitations: Transitional/legacy categories only; do not generalize to ordinary current applications.
This act does not consolidate or amend the text of PD 106/2007.
Greek is the controlling language.
No local copy or republication permission is approved by this link review.

gr-law5226-2025-art28.publisher: National Printing House of the Hellenic Republic; official Gazette copy hosted by the Ministry of Migration and Asylum
gr-law5226-2025-art28.version_or_cutoff: Law 5226/2025, FEK 154/A, 8 September 2025; full official 24-page Gazette PDF inspected.
gr-law5226-2025-art28.scope: Article 28 return procedure and procedural guarantees for EU citizens/family members within PD 106/2007 and specified family members of Greek citizens.
gr-law5226-2025-art28.reviewed_content: Article 28(1) excludes persons who continue to qualify for free movement under the Schengen Borders Code and PD 106/2007; Article 28(2) routes returns through PD 106/2007 Articles 22–24 and applies Law 5226 procedure rules supplementarily for authorities, deadlines, service, guarantees and judicial protection where not contrary to more favourable PD provisions; Article 28(3) addresses specified family members of Greek citizens. Article 41(1) makes the law effective from publication on 8 September 2025.
limitations: This reference covers the stated return/removal and procedural scope, not all residence law.
The law supplements rather than replaces PD 106/2007.
Greek is the controlling language.
No local copy or republication permission is approved by this link review.

gr-mitos-gr-12.scope: EU-citizen registration certificate where the applicant is a family member of another Union citizen; includes the family and stable-relationship categories described by the procedure, with separate treaty grounds to be checked for EEA/Swiss routes.

limitations: This is an administrative procedure reference, not a consolidated legal text.
Use the page only within its displayed scope and update date; Greek is the controlling language.
Check the relevant official Greek statutory provisions and any later material amendment when the legal question depends on current wording.

whole_portal_review_offers.publisher: Gov.gr, Greek government Single Digital Gateway; relevant pages identify the Ministry of Migration and Asylum as the content authority
whole_portal_review_offers.reason: The Greek routes resolve but their page bodies were not exposed in the research client. The English general third-country-family page displays a 28 November 2022 update date, while Law 5275/2026 Article 53 changed specified Article 3(2) residence-document duration with effect from 6 February 2026.
whole_portal_review_offers.review_question: Can a reviewer inspect the whole Gov.gr residence section and identify the current Greek-language pages for each third-country family category, the current card durations and evidence, fees, competent authority, filing route and remedies, and the current update dates after Law 5275/2026 Article 53?
whole_portal_review_offers.effect: The Gov.gr pages remain official discovery leads and are not relied on for current requirements until reviewed. This does not block the five dated MITOS references or other source work.

whole_portal_review_offers.publisher: Ministry of Migration and Asylum, Greece
whole_portal_review_offers.reason: The Greek EU-family guidance page says it was last updated in February 2021. The third-country-family document page exposes no clear update date and includes stale-prone document instructions. Law 5226/2025 and Law 5275/2026 have since changed relevant procedural/legal context.
whole_portal_review_offers.review_question: Can a reviewer inspect the full Ministry immigration-guidance and legislation section, identify current family-route pages and checklists, confirm whether the older pages remain in force, and reconcile third-country-family card categories and durations with the 2025 and 2026 laws?
whole_portal_review_offers.effect: The two pages remain official historical/discovery references; do not rely on their fees, document checklists or card durations as current until reviewed. Independent statutory and MITOS source work continues.

whole_portal_review_offers.reason: The current Greek documents page contains legacy checklist items and states a two-year duration for the stable-partner route; Law 5275/2026 Article 53 changed specified Article 3(2) cases to a five-year Residence Card, effective 6 February 2026.
whole_portal_review_offers.review_question: Can a reviewer inspect the current Attica residence-document pages and confirm which EU-family checklist, partner-card duration, forms, fees and filing channel remain current after Law 5275/2026 Article 53?
whole_portal_review_offers.effect: Attica remains one regional practice sample and is not treated as national policy. Its current route is not relied on for the conflicting duration pending review; other work continues.
